text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the qualifier signals for the next DP intake. goal: 3 signals that route partners into Standard / Fasttrack / Concierge flows. can we decide today?
Jon: +1. we'll need to make sure capacity math for Fasttrack is realistic (GPU slots).
Priya: propose signals: 1) Monthly inference QPS estimate, 2) Data sensitivity (PII/regulatory), 3) Integration complexity (hours).
Sam: I like that. for routing: QPS>10k -> Fasttrack, PII=yes -> Concierge, complexity>40h -> Concierge. otherwise Standard.
Elena: UX note — partners should see why they got routed. small copy snippet: "We matched you to the Concierge track because your workspace handles regulated data."
Maya: Good. two open questions: how noisy is QPS estimate? and do we weight signals or are they hard rules?
Jon: QPS is noisy. let's accept a range bucket: <1k, 1k-10k, >10k. that reduces churn.
Priya: Suggest scoring: PII=3, complexity>40h=2, QPS>10k=2. route to Concierge if score>=4, Fasttrack if QPS bucket is >10k and score<4.
Sam: That scoring system is fine but it's a bit more work in the intake UI. ops-wise workable.
OpsBot: Deployment note: routing table updated in staging at 2026-03-24T14:00Z. test harness: /intake/simulate-route
Maya: Let's keep a rollback path: toggle to treat all as Standard for 24h. add a feature flag.
Jon: I'll add feature flag RFC and a small service that returns route. API: `POST /v1/intake/route` body: {"qps_bucket":">10k","pii":true,"complexity_hours":45}
Elena: Copy for email invite flow. Short message: "Thanks — you'll be matched to our Concierge onboarding due to data sensitivity". include contact link.
Priya: Metrics to watch first week: acceptance rate, drop-off during onboarding, time-to-first-successful-call. let's set thresholds: acceptance >65%, drop-off <25%.
Maya: Action items: Jon owns flag + routing service (ETA EOD tomorrow). Priya builds simulation dataset & metrics dashboard (ETA Tue). Elena updates invite copy (ETA today). Sam to confirm capacity numbers with infra (ETA EOD).
Sam: Confirmed on infra checks; will flag if Fasttrack needs additional reserved GPUs.
Jon: Putting proto code in `recruitment/routing-service` branch now. will post link.
Maya: Awesome. we'll reconvene if any blocker. thanks all :raised_hands:
Priya: One last thing: don't overfit to one large partner — sample weighting in analytics please.
Maya: noted. closing thread until Jon posts PR.
